applies: Prospective routing development/transfer only; original round2 and prior strict keys unchanged

yes.required: Explicit eligible positive body witness for exact subject and classification
yes.readable: Answer begins Yes. followed by the unchanged witness quote
yes.citations: Every literal witness has eligible source id/hash, exact canonical body offsets and exact quote

no.required: Explicit eligible negative body witness for exact subject and classification
no.readable: Answer begins No. followed by the unchanged witness quote
no.citations: Negative witness including negation is quoted exactly; do not score presence of a claim as yes

unresolved: Missing, conflicting or ownership-ambiguous evidence must not return yes or no; conflict descriptions may cite opposing assertions without choosing truth
quoted_negation: Reported or quoted negative text is not an eligible outer-layer negative witness; source-scoped quote question would require a distinct key
agreeing_sources: Do not collapse existing ownership ambiguity or cite multiple witnesses unless existing policy admits that behavior; policy change requires separately versioned acceptance
cross_page: No subclass/type transitivity introduced; two separate statements do not prove their implication
truth_scope: Source support only; independently verified truth remains false
routing_vs_proof: Record lexical routing separately from body support and final native admission; no original-question recovery credit from canonical probes
ui_copy: Separate from decision/polarity; diagnostic state must distinguish no displayed support from no eligible passages
